content.text:
`clone()` on a mesh, line or points object now gives the copy its own materials array. The materials inside it are still shared with the original, as the issue asks.

The fix is one line each in the `copy()` methods of `src/objects/Mesh.js`, `src/objects/Line.js` and `src/objects/Points.js`: if `source.material` is an array, it is copied with `.slice()`; a single material is still shared as before. Subclasses that build on these, such as `SkinnedMesh` and `InstancedMesh`, pick up the change automatically. I left `Sprite` alone because it only takes a single material.

I haven't run any tests or checked the behaviour after the edit.
